top_categories.workout_context: 60ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Lost and Found Gravel's Lost Sierra, Sierra Nevada forest roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 99 miles.
At Lost and Found Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Lost and Found Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Lost and Found Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
5,946ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
At mile 60 of 99, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
5,946ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Lost and Found Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 99 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 99 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Low-cadence force work for 5,946ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Lost and Found Gravel’s 99 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Lost and Found Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on california sierra nevada gravel to build confidence. Expect: lost sierra, sierra nevada forest roads, historic railroad grade.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 99 miles of california sierra nevada gravel in Portola, California.
